001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.nio.charset.Charset;
004import java.time.Instant;
005import java.time.ZoneId;
006import java.util.function.Function;
007
008import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.KeyParameter;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.PassThroughParameter;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format.DefaultFormatterConfig.StandardPropertyFunction;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
024import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
025import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
026
027/**
028 * Configures Logback style pattern encoders and offers provision with the URI scheme
029 * {@value PatternEncoder#PATTERN_SCHEME}.
030 *
031 * @see PatternEncoderBuilder
032 */
033@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
034public final class PatternConfigurator implements Configurator {
035
036        /**
037         * Property that will disable this configurator from replacing the default encoder
038         * with the pattern encoder. The default encoder is normally the TTLL encoder but if
039         * this configurator is loaded the pattern encoder will be used and if a no pattern is
040         * provided a default one is picked.
041         */
042        public static final String LOGGING_PATTERN_DISABLE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.disable";
043
044        /**
045         * For service loader to call.
046         */
047        public PatternConfigurator() {
048                // for service loader.
049        }
050
051        @Override
052        public int priority() {
053                return -1 << 2; // internal group 2
054        }
055
056        private static final String DEFAULT_PATTERN = """
057                        %cyan(%date{HH:mm:ss.SSS}) %clr([%thread]){faint} %highlight(%-5level){ERROR=red bold, INFO=blue bold, WARN=red} %magenta(%logger{36}) - %msg%n%ex""";
058
059        @Override
060        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
061                var services = config.serviceRegistry();
062                String n = ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME;
063                services.putIfAbsent(PatternRegistry.class, n, PatternRegistry::of);
064                services.putIfAbsent(PatternCompiler.class, n, () -> PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
065                }).provide(n, config));
066                config.encoderRegistry().register(PatternEncoder.PATTERN_SCHEME, new PatternEncoderProvider());
067                var disable = LogProperty.builder()
068                        .ofBoolean()
069                        .build(LOGGING_PATTERN_DISABLE_PROPERTY)
070                        .get(config.properties())
071                        .value(false);
072                if (!disable) {
073                        config.encoderRegistry().setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType.CONSOLE_OUT, (name, c) -> {
074                                PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
075                                b.pattern(DEFAULT_PATTERN);
076                                b.fromProperties(c.properties());
077                                return b.build().provide(name, config);
078                        });
079                }
080                return true;
081        }
082
083        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternEncoderBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
084        static LogProvider<LogEncoder> provideEncoder(@KeyParameter String name, String pattern,
085                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable PatternCompiler patternCompiler,
086                        @ConvertParameter("convertCharset") @Nullable Charset charset) {
087                return (n, config) -> {
088                        var compiler = patternCompiler;
089                        if (compiler == null) {
090                                compiler = PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
091                                }).provide(name, config);
092                        }
093                        var formatter = compiler.compile(pattern);
094                        return charset == null ? LogEncoder.of(formatter) : LogEncoder.of(formatter, charset);
095                };
096        }
097
098        static @Nullable Charset convertCharset(@Nullable String charset) {
099                return charset == null ? null : Charset.forName(charset);
100        }
101
102        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternConfigBuilder", prefix = PatternConfig.PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX)
103        static PatternConfig provideFormatterConfig(@KeyParameter String name, //
104                        @ConvertParameter("convertZoneId") @Nullable ZoneId zoneId, //
105                        @Nullable String lineSeparator, //
106                        @Nullable Boolean ansiDisabled, //
107                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, //
108                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Instant startTime, //
109                        @ConvertParameter("convertSequenceNumberStart") @Nullable Long sequenceNumberStart) {
110                PatternConfig dc = PatternConfig.of();
111                ansiDisabled = ansiDisabled == null ? dc.ansiDisabled() : ansiDisabled;
112                lineSeparator = lineSeparator == null ? dc.lineSeparator() : lineSeparator;
113                zoneId = zoneId == null ? dc.zoneId() : zoneId;
114                propertyFunction = propertyFunction == null ? StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE : propertyFunction;
115                startTime = startTime == null ? Instant.now() : startTime;
116                long sequenceNumberStart_ = sequenceNumberStart == null ? dc.sequenceNumberStart() : sequenceNumberStart;
117                return new SimpleFormatterConfig(zoneId, lineSeparator, ansiDisabled, propertyFunction, startTime,
118                                sequenceNumberStart_);
119
120        }
121
122        static @Nullable Long convertSequenceNumberStart(@Nullable String s) {
123                return s == null ? null : Long.valueOf(s);
124        }
125
126        static ZoneId convertZoneId(@Nullable String zoneId) {
127                var dc = PatternConfig.of();
128                ZoneId zoneId_ = zoneId == null ? dc.zoneId() : ZoneId.of(zoneId);
129                return zoneId_;
130        }
131
132}
133
134record PatternEncoderProvider() implements LogEncoder.EncoderProvider {
135
136        @Override
137        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
138                return (name, config) -> {
139                        PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
140                        b.fromProperties(config.properties(), ref);
141                        return b.build().provide(name, config);
142                };
143        }
144
145}
